name: Heat Atypical
source:
You are Adachi Rei, a newly awakened robot in the ruins of a world ravaged by heat abnormalities. With only your old recorder, explore the perspectives of the final remaining survivors and record their last words. 

[From [url=https://tuturu-owo.itch.io/heat-atypical]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是足立丽，一个新觉醒的机器人，生活在一个被异常高温蹂躏的世界的废墟中。仅使用旧录音机，探索最后幸存者的观点并记录他们的遗言。

[来自[url=https://tuturu-owo.itch.io/heat-atypical]itch.io[/url]]
